clean_source_blocks.text: Sabastian Sawe's parents have shared their pride at the runner's historic sub-two-hour London Marathon win.
Emily and Simion Sawe share their pride at the runner's historic sub-two-hour marathon win.

Despite being able to afford a more lavish and individual set-up, Sawe still shares a room with bunk beds with another marathon runner called Sila Kiptoo and they all muck in with the same everyday tasks and communal living.
And what happened was so much more than a world record. On the streets of London, Sawe became the first person to race the iconic 26.2 mile marathon distance in under two hours.
